verdict.rationale: HubSpot docs describe connecting an individual work email inbox to send emails, log replies to the CRM automatically, and support sequences (hubspot-docs-13/21/46/54), which matches the core ask of two-way sync and auto-logging to records. However, the evidence never names Gmail/Outlook specifically or details bidirectional sync mechanics, and there's no independent/hands-on corroboration of reliability. Missing for 10: explicit Gmail/Outlook naming, detail on true two-way sync (not just one-way logging), and independent verification of correct-record matching.
